{{Top|leg}}
'''Nohrwan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who served during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when blackmailers acquired compromising [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] of him. The senator was relieved to have the incriminating holovids returned to him.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Incriminating Footage}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In a later update of the game, Nohrwan is considered a [[General/Legends|General]].
